questions.question_text:
Find $x$ in the right angle.

\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large},scale=0.9]\usetikzlibrary{angles,quotes}\coordinate (O) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (2.4,0);\coordinate (B) at (0,2.4);\coordinate (C) at (33:2.1);\draw (O)--(A);\draw (O)--(B);\draw (O)--(C);\pic[draw,"$33^{\circ}$",angle radius=0.55cm,angle eccentricity=2]{angle=A--O--C};\pic[draw,"$x$",angle radius=0.8cm,angle eccentricity=1.8]{angle=C--O--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

options.why: Subtracts 33 from 100 instead of from the right-angle total of 90.
Adds 33 to 180 by using a straight-line total.
Subtracts 33 from 360 by using a full-turn total.

questions.question_text:
A right angle contains $21^{\circ}$, $34^{\circ}$ and $y$.
Find $y$.
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large},scale=0.9]\usetikzlibrary{angles,quotes}\coordinate (O) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (2.5,0);\coordinate (B) at (0,2.5);\coordinate (C) at (21:2.2);\coordinate (D) at (55:2.2);\draw (O)--(A);\draw (O)--(B);\draw (O)--(C);\draw (O)--(D);\pic[draw,"$21^{\circ}$",angle radius=0.5cm,angle eccentricity=2]{angle=A--O--C};\pic[draw,"$34^{\circ}$",angle radius=0.72cm,angle eccentricity=2]{angle=C--O--D};\pic[draw,"$y$",angle radius=0.95cm,angle eccentricity=1.8]{angle=D--O--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

options.why: Adds the two known angles but does not subtract their total from 90.
Subtracts only 21 plus 24 after misreading 34 as 24.
Adds the known-angle total to 70 instead of completing the 90-degree corner.

questions.question_text:
The outside arms form a right angle.
Find $b$.
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large},scale=0.9]\usetikzlibrary{angles,quotes}\coordinate (O) at (0,0);\coordinate (A) at (25:2.4);\coordinate (B) at (115:2.4);\coordinate (C) at (86:2.1);\draw (O)--(A);\draw (O)--(B);\draw (O)--(C);\pic[draw,"$61^{\circ}$",angle radius=0.55cm,angle eccentricity=2]{angle=A--O--C};\pic[draw,"$b$",angle radius=0.8cm,angle eccentricity=1.8]{angle=C--O--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

options.why: Subtracts 61 from 80 instead of from the 90-degree total.
Subtracts 61 from 100 rather than using the right-angle total.
Uses 180 degrees as the total for the rotated square corner.

questions.question_text:

What is $c$?

options.why: Subtracts 72 from 100 instead of from 90 degrees.
Subtracts 72 from a straight-angle total of 180 degrees.

questions.question_text:
A right angle is split into $16^{\circ}$, $x$ and $38^{\circ}$.
Find $x$.

options.why: Adds the two known angles and reports their sum as the missing angle.
Subtracts only the 38-degree angle from 90 and ignores 16 degrees.
Subtracts only the 16-degree angle from 90 and ignores 38 degrees.

questions.question_text:
One part of a right angle is $9^{\circ}$ more than $36^{\circ}$.
What is the other part?

options.why: Subtracts 36 from 90 before adding the extra 9 degrees.
Subtracts 36 from 90 and then adds 9 instead of forming the known angle first.
Subtracts the extra 9 degrees from 36 and reports that unrelated difference.
